target_claims.statement: A union-closed family containing {a} has a in at least half of its members.
A union-closed family containing {a,b} has at least one of a or b in at least half of its members.
Exact independent replay finds no nontrivial violation on universes n <= 4.

For every exact D003 functional-preorder order-ideal family F on U, the carrier-relative complement family is union-closed, nontrivial, and Frankl-abundant; D004 average rarity also dualizes to average abundance.

inputs: Previously qualified MATHCERT Lean sources and bounded n <= 4 replay for the existing UC claims.

Protected MATHSOLVE source commit dbfbb117ef1e3733268da6590c824a330c69ee64, especially MathSolve/UnionClosed/FunctionalPreorderBridge.lean, FunctionalPreorderD004.lean, and FunctionalPreorderD005.lean.

Exact WP07 D005 proof chain: functional-preorder intersection closure, carrier-relative complement union closure, complement cardinality/frequency identities, double-counted rare-element extraction from D004 average rarity, and restricted Frankl-abundance endgame.
checker_contract.acceptance: Independently replay the exact WP07 theorem surface and accept UC-WP07-P006 only if the D003 hypothesis, D004 dependency, complement semantics, frequency arithmetic, and universal nonpromotion boundary are preserved without placeholders or added unexplained axioms.
checker_contract.rejection: Reject semantic drift, substitution of WP06 IsIdealFamilyOn for the D003 predicate, failed replay, changed source identity, hidden representation assumptions, or any promotion of UC-WP07-P006 to UC-P04 or UC-FRANKL.

claim_boundary: The new WP07 claim covers only complements of families already represented by the exact functional-preorder order-ideal predicate. It does not prove that arbitrary finite union-closed families admit this representation, does not close UC-P04, and does not prove Frankl's conjecture.
reopening_conditions: Reopen if the D003, D004, or D005 theorem statements, protected MATHSOLVE source identity, checker identity, complement representation predicate, universal bridge status, finite replay range, or MATHCERT disposition changes.
